name: Warsong Lumber Camp
summary: Warsong Lumber Camp cuts Ashenvale timber for the Horde and keeps its conflict with the night elves alive. Kargathia Keep guards the operation.

sections.title: Heart of the Harvest
sections.body:
In eastern Ashenvale, Warsong Lumber Camp cuts through the dense canopy for the Horde. Orc peons and hired goblin engineers drive whirring shredders through towering trunks, making lumber for nearby Splintertree Post and the fledgling nation of Durotar.

Kargathia Keep anchors the camp's defenses against night elf counterattacks. War wolves wait in an active kennel. To the Warsong, every felled tree means survival and strength. To the native Sentinels, each saw blade is an act of sacrilege.

sections.title: A Legacy of War
sections.body:
Warsong clan warriors first entered these woods with Grom Hellscream during the Third War, seeking timber for the Horde. Their clearing enraged the demigod Cenarius and drew the ancient wrath of the night elves.

Now Thrall's Horde banners fly over the camp, but old hatreds still burn. Untamed timber, hostile elves, and demonic corruption around neighboring Felfire Hill surround it. Its defenders stay armed around the clock, axes in hand as they harvest, ready to abandon the lumber when the next ambush comes.

faq.q: Why is the Horde logging in Ashenvale?
faq.answer: The Horde's lands, especially Durotar and the Barrens, are arid and sparse, with little timber for buildings, palisades, or war machinery. Ashenvale supplies wood for outposts like Splintertree Post and the capital of Orgrimmar to survive and grow.

Kargathia Keep is the fortified stronghold at Warsong Lumber Camp. It provides barracks, strategic command, and a reinforced refuge where peons and overseers can hold off night elf ambushes or attacks by local wildlife.

faq.q: Why are the night elves so hostile to this camp?
faq.answer: Night elves see Ashenvale as a sacred ancestral homeland, protected by nature spirits and ancients. They consider the felling of ancient trees with noisy, smoke-belching goblin machinery wanton destruction and desecration, so they attack to drive the Warsong orcs from the forest.

faq.q: What role do goblins play in the camp?
faq.answer: Goblin mercenaries and technicians supply specialized equipment for the lumber operation, especially steam-powered shredders. These machines let the Warsong harvest and strip massive ancient trees far faster than hand axes can.

angles.text: The lumber cut here supplies building materials for Splintertree Post and fortifications that protect the Horde's future across Kalimdor.
As a night elf, you hear the shredders and see the falling trees as a brutal assault on Ashenvale's sacred balance. The Sentinels have vowed to end it.
